facts.fact: The Presidency says the Commission de l'informatique et des libertes, led by president Dr Halguieta Nassa/Trawina, handed its 2022 activity report to the Head of State on 23 February 2024.
facts.system: Commission de l'informatique et des libertes (CIL)

systems.system: Commission de l'informatique et des libertes (CIL)

note: About 100 complaints are said to be registered, not settled, and no ruling against a named organisation is stated.
